title: Modern Ed25519 Edwards-Curve Digital Signature
description: Tests modern Edwards-curve JCA Signature instantiation with Ed25519 algorithm.

expected_findings.evaluation_notes: Scanners must recognize Ed25519 signature algorithm (RFC 8032). Ed25519 is a digital signature scheme distinct from X25519/Curve25519 key agreement. Operational role is determinable as digital_signature based on Signature API usage. curve_name is null as no explicit curve parameter is passed in code.

verification_metadata.verification_method: Manual Source Code Inspection & JCA Spec Cross-Check
